title: Optimize a growing real encoder selector from actual Bernoulli effects
status_authority: Acquired completed base/refinement, controls and statistics receipts. The refinement leaves the original Frobenius/majority proof immutable and credits the bounded-matrix concentration import.

scientific_scope_status: Received active-effect constructions optimize a supplied growing real m-dimensional selector after freezing the physical decoder. The elementary route has O_tilde(m^4/(gamma^2 epsilon)) calls; the separately received bounded-matrix/terminal-stage refinement gives O_tilde(m^3/(gamma epsilon)). Actual Bernoulli records, rational preconditioners, finite caps and m-anchor transfers are retained.
